about_the_game:
Medieval StartUp: Manage Your Tavern in the Heart of a Mysterious Swamp

Dive into a unique blend of management, crafting and exploration! As the proprietor of a tavern nestled in an enchanting swamp, you’ll balance finances, resources and customer satisfaction to turn your humble inn into a legendary institution.

Demo Highlights (1 Hour of Gameplay)

  • Immersive Tutorial

    Master the core mechanics over 4 in-game days (multiple playthroughs let you uncover every nuance).

  • Complete Tavern Management

    • Serve your patrons

    • Hire staff (bartenders, cooks, lumberjacks, carpenters…)

    • Oversee inventory and personnel

  • Crafting
    Transform harvested goods into furniture, hearty dishes and signature brews.

  • Exploration & Secrets
    Venture into the swamp to gather rare resources and unearth the mysteries of a forgotten realm.

Graphics & Soundscape

  • Low-Poly Visual Style
    A polished aesthetic that immerses you in a medieval world.

  • Dynamic Lighting
    Experience a living environment as day shifts to night, adding realism to your tavern—and the mysterious swamp around it.

Dive into the world of Medieval StartUp and turn your humble tavern into a flourishing institution at the heart of the kingdom!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.4GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or better, OpenGL Support required
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3400 MB available space

reviews:
“Plenty of great ideas for a relaxing little low-pixel game. Farm/build/optimize your small medieval business. The EA gives a rather promising taste of the game.”
Telum Deos

“A game full of great ideas and very interesting. Easy to pick up, it will allow anyone to try it. Although incomplete for now, it is infinitely more complete than AAA games”
Escadron Griffons
short_description: Medieval StartUp is a unique mix of tavern management, crafting, and exploration set in a rich medieval world. Manage your tavern, craft unique items, recruit staff, and explore a mysterious marsh full of hidden secrets and rare resources.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
